title: 99 Pond Cypress Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 99 Pond Cypress Way is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Tucked within the highly coveted Camp District of WaterColor, this 5 Bedroom, 5.5 Bath luxury retreat was designed for the kind of vacations that become family traditions. Homes offering this level of architectural detail, courtyard privacy, and premier location in the Camp District are limited. Mornings begin with coffee on the columned front porch swing, afternoons drift between the private courtyard pool and the beach, and evenings gather around the outdoor fireplace as the spa glows just steps away. Defined by soaring ceilings, layered millwork, wide-plank wood floors, and walls of windows that flood the interiors with natural light, the home blends classic coastal architecture with refined finishes throughout. With a private heated courtyard pool and elevated spa, expansive porches, a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, and a 6 Passenger Electric Cart, this home offers the scale, comfort, and amenities that make multi-generational getaways feel effortless. Just a 3-minute walk to Camp WaterColor and a 5-minute bike ride to both the Beach Club and Seaside, guests enjoy premier access while retreating each evening to a quiet, upscale residential setting.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 12 Passes Included. 6-Passenger Electric Cart Parking for 2 Vehicles 6 Adult Bikes Included Private Pool with Spa (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Full Outdoor Kitchen with Gas Grill, Green Egg, and Pizza Oven Covered Outdoor Living Area with Fireplace Exterior Shower Sonos Sound System Located in the Heart of WaterColor’s Camp District 3-Minute Walk to Camp WaterColor 5-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Home From the moment you enter, soaring ceilings and abundant natural light create an immediate sense of calm. The open-concept layout allows everyone to stay connected while still feeling spacious and intentional in design. The chef’s kitchen is centered around an oversized marble island that seats six, illuminated by designer pendant lighting and framed by custom cabinetry in soft coastal tones. Professional-grade appliances and generous prep space make entertaining seamless. The adjoining living room offers generous seating, a fireplace, and tall windows that anchor the space with warmth and architectural character. Step outside to the covered outdoor living room, complete with fireplace, mounted television, heaters, and lounge seating beneath vaulted ceilings and detailed millwork. The fully equipped outdoor kitchen with gas grill, Green Egg, pizza oven, and beverage refrigerator transforms dinner into an experience. The private courtyard pool and elevated spa create a true resort-style setting rarely found in WaterColor. Stepping pads across the water add both visual interest and function, while thoughtful landscaping enhances privacy and ambiance. The second floor features three King bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bathroom, offering comfort and privacy for adult guests. The primary suite serves as a serene retreat, complete with a freestanding soaking tub, expansive glass-enclosed shower wrapped in soft sea-glass tile, marble flooring, private sitting area, and balcony access. The third floor was designed with flexibility and intention. A Queen bedroom with private bath, a dedicated bunk room with two Twin-over-Twin bunks, and a thoughtfully arranged lounge and play area create the perfect space for kids, teens, or additional guests. The shared bath features a walk-in shower, and the wet bar with wine fridge and microwave makes movie nights, morning coffee, or relaxed evenings effortless. Every level of the home balances gathering spaces with quiet retreats, giving everyone room to unwind while keeping connection at the center.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Laundry Room Half Bathroom Kitchen Living Room Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Shared Sitting Area with Coffee Bar Third Floor Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bunk Room: Two Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Living Area: Day Bed with Trundle (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Life in WaterColor The Camp District places you just steps from Camp WaterColor’s resort-style pools, lazy river, playground, and expansive green spaces. A short walk or bike ride connects you to the WaterColor Beach Club and the shops and restaurants of Seaside. From mornings at Camp WaterColor to afternoons at the Beach Club and evenings gathered around the courtyard fireplace, this home captures the rhythm of life in WaterColor. With its private pool, architectural detail, and walkable location, it offers a refined yet relaxed place to return to at the end of each day.
